withdrawal_fee_unit: synthetic Q raw atoms (test-only; rUSD has six decimals in this fixture)
stable_fee_asset_definition: Tagged(B3/FM2/TEST_ASSET, raw UTF-8 rUSD); synthetic regtest asset only, no backing or production-token claim
profile_hash_definition: Tagged(B3/FM2/PROFILE, encoded_profile); hex in raw byte order, not uint256 GetHex
scope: Separate prerelease stable-Q REGTEST profile with exact-view COMMIT certificates; legacy /1 archives keep commitment2 and original signatures
limitations: No non-Q quote valuation or separate-fee reservation implementation
Wider asset-to-asset markets and futures remain required product scope
No production stablecoin, economics, custody model or activation selected
commit_digest_definition: Tagged(B3/FM2/COMMIT, u8{3} || canonical 366-byte SlotHeaderV2 || u64 little-endian view)
certificate_extension: optional u64 little-endian view after legacy bytes; required for commitment3 including zero, forbidden for commitment0/2
archive_policy: Existing /1 journals, deployments and keys are retained. Open them only with their original /1 identity/rules; /2 refuses mismatched identity and never resets history.
